title: Project HTTP facade
summary: Account-scoped Project creation/list/read using existing Runtime v1 HTTP shapes.

replaceability.why: Holds Project integrity or trusted execution authority; replacing it requires Lumeri control.

reach.notes: Trusted Runtime seam, not an additional grant to a creator Luc.

operations.name: GET /projects
operations.notes: No fixed request deadline is enforced at this route. Lists account-owned projects.

operations.name: POST /projects
operations.notes: No fixed request deadline is enforced at this route. Creates revision-zero descriptor. source_root import is refused; optional project_id is supported in code. No client_op_id result protocol or atomic Project multi-file commit; omitted id creates another Project on retry.

operations.name: GET /projects/{project_id}
operations.notes: No fixed request deadline is enforced at this route. Account mismatch is hidden by repository not-found behavior.

invariants.text: Project and Session access is resolved using verified account identity; a path id alone supplies no ownership authority.

break: An unhandled exception, invalid output, or failed declared artifact check.
failure.notes: The original reports failure today. The self-Luc run gate and original fallback are requirements for a future replacement, not a promise this seam already implements.

conformance.notes: Contract schema checking is available; replacement conformance is not wired at this seam.

known_deviations.text: Runtime type descriptors list source_root but creation rejects nonempty values; code also accepts project_id, which that descriptor omits. Request operation is draft for this mismatch.
